description:
- Led and developed automation engineering teams in AOI 1 and AOI 2, including serving as Group Leader in the Machine Automation Division.
- Designed, developed, and implemented Special Purpose Machines (SPM) to automate manual production processes in garment manufacturing.
- Developed various automation projects, including:
  - Automatic Heat Transfer Machine – 29 units.
  - Automatic Adidas Hangtag Label Applicator – 2 units.
  - Automatic Garment Folding Machine – 1 unit.
  - Automatic Elastic Waistband Cutting Machine – 2 units.
  - Automatic Cut & Arrange 3 Stripes Attachment – 4 units.
- Developed industrial automation systems involving PLC programming, HMI, sensors, actuators, electrical controls, and machine integration.
- Participated in Industry 4.0 initiatives, including the development of an IoT-based Electrical Power Monitoring System.
- Supported machine maintenance, troubleshooting, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
- Managed machine development activities from concept, design, prototyping, testing, through production implementation.
